name: taskPilot
description: taskPilot is a lightweight, Monday-style workspace for boards, custom tables, item chat, public forms, and workflow automation. This connector brings your own AI into taskPilot: ask it to pull up a board, triage a list, fill in fields, or leave a comment, and it works directly in your boards on your behalf. Access is authorized per user via OAuth 2.1 with an explicit consent screen, scoped to reads plus safe writes (create and update items and comments only — no destructive actions), and revocable anytime from Integrations → AI assistant.

_published_faq.name: How do I add taskPilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add taskPilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://taskpilot.nocodeminute.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the taskPilot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: taskPilot provides these MCP tools: add_item_comment, create_item, get_board, get_item, list_boards, list_item_comments, list_items, search_items, and update_item_cells.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to taskPilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to taskPilot in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
taskPilot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
taskPilot is developed by NoCodeMinute LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
